name: Lab inventory
description: Reads the Acme plate reader's files, prints compact cryo labels with Code 39 barcodes, and keeps samples out of units that are too warm for them.
author: Acme Bio

instrument-parsers.title: Acme PlateReader 3000
instrument-parsers.description: Reads the CSV the Acme PlateReader 3000 exports: a few lines about the run, then one line per well.

label-formats.title: Compact cryo label
label-formats.description: The ID in bold, then the sample type and lot on one line, then where it is kept and its use-by date.

barcode-formats.title: Code 39
barcode-formats.description: Draws the ID as a Code 39 barcode, and reads a scanned Code 39 back into an ID (case and the * start and stop marks do not matter).

storage-rules.title: Keep samples cold enough
storage-rules.description: Refuses a sample that needs −80 °C in a unit that is warmer than −60 °C, and warns when a box is nearly full.
